DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどの届け出についてですね。控えに気になる点がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about the report you filed earlier, correct? Did you notice something on your copy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 財布の遺失届の控えを見たら、携帯番号の最後の数字が違っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遺失届控えの携帯番号末尾が違うと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I looked at my copy of the lost-wallet report, the last digit of my mobile number was wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the last digit of the mobile number on your lost-property report copy is wrong. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えを見せてください。ご本人のお名前と届け出た時刻もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the copy. I'll also need your name and the time you filed the report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: グエン・ミンです。一時間ほど前に届けて、この控えを受け取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名と一時間前の届け出を示し控えを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm Nguyen Minh. I reported it about an hour ago and received this copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your full name, say you filed the report an hour ago, and show the copy. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付の記録と照合しますね。正しい番号を、こちらの確認欄に記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll compare it with our reception record. Please write the correct number in this verification field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この番号です。最後は八ではなく六です、途中の数字も一緒に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正しい番号を書き末尾八でなく六と伝え全桁確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here's the number. It ends in six, not eight; could you check the other digits too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write the correct number, say the last digit is six rather than eight, and ask for every digit to be checked. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、全体を確認します。連絡先の訂正として担当へ伝えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I'll check the whole number. I'll tell the person in charge that it's a contact-detail correction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 前の番号にもう電話されていたかも、確認できますか。別の人にかかったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 誤番号に既に電話したか連絡履歴の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Can you also check whether anyone has already called the previous number? It may have reached someone else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the contact history to be checked to see whether the wrong number has already been called. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 連絡の状況も確認します。今ここでは電話済みかどうか判断できないので、担当からの説明をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the contact status too. I can't determine here right now whether a call has been made, so please wait for the person in charge to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 訂正と連絡状況の確認をお願いします。控えも直した物を受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先訂正と履歴確認および訂正済み控えを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please correct the number and check the contact status. I'd also like a corrected copy of the report.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request a correction of your contact number, a check of the contact history, and a corrected report copy. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。ご確認に戻っていただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Thank you for returning to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱のふたが少し浮いていますね。閉じた状態でお持ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The box lid is lifting a little. Could you bring it in with the lid properly closed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: タオルを入れすぎたようです。上から強く押してテープで止めてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: タオルの詰めすぎを説明し押し込んで封をしてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I seem to have put in too many towels. May I push down hard from above and tape it shut?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you packed too many towels and ask whether you may push them down and seal the box. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に押すと箱が変形するので、中身の量か箱の大きさを見直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Forcing it down will deform the box, so let's reconsider the amount inside or the box size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: タオルを二枚抜けば閉まりそうです。いったん持ち帰って詰め直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚減らせば閉まると伝え持ち帰って詰め直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It looks like it will close if I remove two towels. I'll take it home for now and repack it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say removing two towels should let it close and that you'll take it home to repack. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それがよいですね。箱の継ぎ目が開かないよう、梱包も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That sounds good. Check the packaging too so the box seams won't come open.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前に使った箱なので、古い宛名のシールも残っています。それもはがしたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再利用箱の古い宛名シールも除去すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a reused box, so there's an old address sticker too. Should I peel that off as well?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the old address sticker on the reused box should also be removed. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 古い宛名や送り状は取り除き、新しい宛先だけわかるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Remove old addresses and shipping labels so only the new destination is identifiable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古いシールを外して、タオルを減らします。重さと送料は詰め直したあとに測るのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 古いシール除去と減量を確認し送料測定のタイミングを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll remove the old sticker and reduce the towels. So the weight and shipping charge are checked after I've repacked it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm removing the old sticker and reducing the contents, and ask when the shipping charge will be assessed. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、最終的な荷物の状態で確認します。箱が傷んでいたら、新しい物へ入れ替えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we'll check the parcel in its final condition. If the box is damaged, replace it with a new one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 箱の傷みも家で見直して、ふたが自然に閉まる状態にしてから持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱の傷みを確認し無理なく閉じる状態で再持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the box for damage at home too and bring it back with the lid able to close naturally.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the box for damage and bring it back so it closes without force. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お手数をおかけします。それでは、お気をつけてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sorry for the trouble. Please take it home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の申込書ですね。記入する名前についてお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a transfer application form. Are you unsure which name to enter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大家さんから、名前の前に部屋番号を付けるよう言われました。どこに書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃振込に部屋番号を名前の前へ付ける記入場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My landlord told me to add my room number before my name. Where should I write that?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to put the room number before your name for the rent transfer. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手に表示する依頼人名の欄を確認しましょう。大家さんの案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the sender-name field that will be shown to the recipient. Do you have your landlord's instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯のこの連絡です。「二〇三、グエン」とありますが、私はグエン・ミンです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大家の指定表示と本人氏名の違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This message on my phone. It says “203, Nguyen,” but my name is Nguyen Minh.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the difference between the landlord's specified display and your full name. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その表示で相手が確認できるか、案内と照らし合わせてください。口座の名義を書く欄とは分けて見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Compare that with the instructions to see whether the recipient can identify you from it. Let's distinguish it from the field for the account holder's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 依頼人名には二〇三とグエン、本人の名義欄にはグエン・ミンと書くのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 依頼人表示と口座名義を別欄に記入すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I write 203 and Nguyen in the sender-name field, and Nguyen Minh in my own account-name field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll enter the sender display and account holder's name in separate fields. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、こちらの申込書では別の欄です。振込先と金額も、大家さんの案内から確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, they're separate fields on this form. Check the destination account and amount against your landlord's instructions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金額は六万円です。部屋番号を付け忘れたまま送らないよう、送信前に見直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 六万円と伝え振込前の部屋番号表示の再確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The amount is sixty thousand yen. Can I review it before sending so I don't send it without the room number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the amount of sixty thousand yen and request another check of the room-number display before the transfer. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付で内容を確認しますので、手続きが終わる前に依頼人名もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the contents at reception, so please also confirm the sender's name before the procedure is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 六万円の振込先と依頼人名を確認してからお願いします。部屋番号は二〇三です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 振込先金額と二〇三の依頼人名を確かめて進めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please proceed after checking the destination for the sixty-thousand-yen transfer and the sender's name. The room number is 203.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the destination, amount, and sender name including 203 before proceeding. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、記入済みの用紙をこちらへお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please hand me the completed form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 買った物のお忘れ物でしょうか。レシートをお持ちでしたら拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you leave something you bought behind? If you have the receipt, please show me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 卵を買ったのに、家で袋を開けたらありませんでした。袋詰め台に置いたままかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入した卵が自宅の袋になく袋詰め台への置き忘れを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought eggs, but they weren't in the bag when I opened it at home. I may have left them on the bagging counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the eggs you bought weren't in your bag at home and ask about leaving them on the bagging counter. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 卵の購入は記録にありますね。どの袋詰め台をお使いでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The purchase of eggs is recorded. Which bagging counter did you use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出口に近い台です。牛乳とパンを入れてから、卵は最後に入れるつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出口近くの台で牛乳とパンを先に詰めたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The one near the exit. I put the milk and bread in first and meant to put the eggs in last.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you packed milk and bread first at the counter near the exit. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その台の忘れ物が届いているか確認します。ご購入は三十分ほど前でお間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check whether anything left at that counter was handed in. You bought them about thirty minutes ago, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、三十分前です。十個入りの白い卵で、透明なパックでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三十分前の購入と十個入り白卵透明パックの特徴を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, thirty minutes ago. They were ten white eggs in a clear pack.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the purchase was thirty minutes ago and describe ten white eggs in clear packaging. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 特徴も確認しますね。お忘れ物と思われるパックはありますが、お渡しする前に購入内容を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check those features too. We have a pack that may be yours, but we'll match it to your purchase before handing it over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: レシートで確認してください。卵を受け取ったら、パックの傷みや卵の割れも見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: レシート照合と受取時の卵の状態確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please check against my receipt. When I receive the eggs, I'd also like to check the pack for damage and the eggs for cracks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a receipt check and a check of the eggs' condition when collecting them. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できましたので、こちらがそのパックです。状態に気になる点があれば、その場でお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've confirmed it, so here's the pack. If anything about its condition concerns you, tell us here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: これです、卵も割れていません。今度は袋に入れた物を数えてから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の卵で割れもないと確認し次回は袋の中身を数えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: This is it, and the eggs aren't cracked. Next time I'll count what's in my bag before going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm these are your eggs and they're unbroken, and say you'll count your bag's contents next time. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見つかってよかったです。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad they were found. Get home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遊具の近くで上着を見つけられたのですね。今もそこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You found a jacket near the playground equipment, correct? Is it still there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 滑り台の横の柵にかかっています。勝手に持ってきてよいかわからず、そのままにしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 滑り台横の柵の上着を移動せず残したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's hanging on the fence beside the slide. I wasn't sure whether I could bring it here myself, so I left it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you left the jacket on the fence beside the slide without moving it. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所を教えてくださってありがとうございます。どんな色の上着ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for telling us the location. What color is the jacket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 子ども用の黄色い上着です。フードに小さな耳が付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 黄色い子供用でフードに耳がある特徴を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: A yellow child's jacket. There are small ears on the hood.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe a yellow child's jacket with ears on its hood. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 私が確認に行きます。近くに持ち主らしい方はいらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll go and check. Was anyone nearby who seemed to be the owner?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十分ほど見ていましたが、取りに来る人はいませんでした。私はそろそろ帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十分間持ち主が現れず自分は帰ると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I watched for about ten minutes, but nobody came to collect it. I'm about to head home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that no owner appeared for ten minutes and you're leaving. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、職員が引き継ぎます。ご自身で持ち主を探し続けなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then staff will take over. You don't need to keep looking for the owner yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰る途中で上着を探している人に会ったら、管理所へ行くよう伝えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 探す人に会えば管理所へ案内してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I meet someone looking for a jacket on my way home, may I tell them to go to the management office?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may direct someone looking for it to the management office. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、職員に確認するようお伝えください。その方の物かは、こちらで特徴を伺って確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, tell them to check with staff. We'll ask about its features here to confirm whether it's theirs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 管理所で確認してもらうよう伝えます。上着は職員の方にお任せして帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 探す人へ職員確認を案内し保管を任せて帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell them to have it checked at the management office. I'll leave the jacket to the staff and go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll direct anyone searching to staff for verification and leave the jacket's care to staff as you go home. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お気遣いありがとうございます。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your consideration. Please get home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 忘れ物のご相談ですか。どこでなくしたと思われますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here about lost property? Where do you think you lost it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっき降りた列車の席に、灰色の帽子を置いたままにしたと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 降車した列車の席に灰色の帽子を忘れた可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I think I left a gray hat on the seat of the train I just got off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you may have left a gray hat on the seat of the train you got off. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗っていた列車の時刻や、車両の位置は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember the train's time or which carriage you were in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここに着いたのは十分ほど前です。先頭から二両目の窓側に座っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着約十分前と二両目窓側の乗車位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It arrived here about ten minutes ago. I was in a window seat in the second carriage from the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the arrival time of about ten minutes ago and your window seat in the second carriage. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その情報を記録します。帽子に、見分けられる模様などはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll record that information. Does the hat have a distinctive pattern or other identifying feature?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 内側に青い糸で名前を縫ってあります。外からは見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帽子の内側に青糸で縫った名前を識別特徴として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My name is stitched inside in blue thread. It can't be seen from outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the name stitched inside the hat in blue thread as its identifying feature. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 特徴も添えて照会します。見つかったかどうか、今の時点で分かる情報をお伝えしますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll include those features in the inquiry. I'll tell you what we can find out right now about whether it's been found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで照会の結果を待ちます。すぐ分からなければ、後で問い合わせる方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 照会を待ち未発見時の後日の問い合わせ方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait here for the inquiry result. If you can't find out immediately, please tell me how to ask again later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait for the inquiry and ask how to inquire later if it isn't found. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今確認できた範囲と、その後の問い合わせ先を分けてご案内します。連絡の取れる番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll explain separately what we've confirmed now and whom to contact afterward. Do you have a number we can reach you at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 携帯番号を書きます。列車の情報と帽子の内側の名前が伝わったか、最後に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を記入し列車情報と帽子の特徴の伝達を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write my mobile number. Lastly, I'd like to confirm that the train details and the name inside the hat have been passed on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write your contact number and confirm the train details and hat features have been communicated. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二両目の窓側と、内側の名前も記録できました。ご相談ありがとうございました、どうぞお気を付けて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've recorded the second-carriage window seat and the name inside. Thank you for asking us; take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請書の記入で、ご不明な欄はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any fields on the application you aren't sure about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 提出先から証明書の名前は聞きましたが、使用目的の欄に何を書けばよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 証明書名は分かるが使用目的欄の記載に迷っていると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The recipient told me the certificate's name, but I'm not sure what to write in the purpose-of-use field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you know the certificate's name but need help with the purpose-of-use field. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらへ、何の手続きのために提出する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where are you planning to submit it, and for what procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勤務先へ出します。通勤手当の登録で住所を確認するため、と言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先の通勤手当登録で住所確認のため提出すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: To my workplace. They said it's to confirm my address for registering my commuting allowance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain it's for address verification when registering a commuting allowance at work. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その用件を使用目的の欄に書いてください。証明書名の指定も、案内と照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Write that reason in the purpose field. Let's also check the specified certificate name against the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内の名前と申請書の名前は同じでした。必要な枚数が分からないので、一枚と決めてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 証明書名の一致を確認し必要枚数を一枚と決めてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The name in the instructions matches the form. I don't know how many copies are needed; may I just decide on one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the certificate names match and ask whether you may choose one copy without knowing the required number. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要枚数は提出先に確認してください。分からないまま何枚も申請する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ask the recipient how many copies are needed. You don't need to request several without knowing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では勤務先へ枚数を確認してから、この欄を埋めます。今書いた使用目的も見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務先へ枚数を確かめる方針を示し使用目的の記載を見てもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll fill in this field after confirming the number with work. Could you also check the purpose I just wrote?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the number of copies with work and ask for your written purpose to be reviewed. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 勤務先の通勤手当登録、と書かれていますね。提出先から追加の指定があれば、申請前にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: It says “commuting-allowance registration at work.” If the recipient gives any additional requirements, tell us before applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 使用目的はこのままにして、枚数だけ勤務先の返事を待ちます。まだ申請は出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 使用目的を残し枚数回答まで申請を提出しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave the purpose as it is and wait for work's answer about the number of copies. I won't submit the application yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll keep the purpose as written and won't submit until you get an answer on the number of copies. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。確認が済んだらお声掛けください、それでは失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: All right. Let us know once you've checked. I'll leave you for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 看護師です。お名前を確認してから、お話を伺いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'm a nurse. I'll confirm your name before hearing what you need to tell us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名前はこちらです。周りの音が大きくて、今の質問がよく聞こえませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人の名前を示し周囲の音で質問を聞き取れなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here's my name. The surroundings are noisy, so I couldn't hear that question clearly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show your name and say surrounding noise prevented you from hearing the question. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 聞こえにくかったのですね。お顔を見ながら、一つずつ短く伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It was hard to hear, then. I'll face you and ask short questions one at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。聞き取れた言葉を私が繰り返すので、合っているか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 聞き取った言葉を復唱して正誤を確認してもらう方法を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I'll repeat the words I hear, so please tell me whether I've got them right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to repeat what you hear and have the other person check whether it's correct. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は、どのような症状でいらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. What symptoms brought you here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日から左の肩が痛みます。腕を上げると痛む、という説明で伝わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 左肩の痛みの開始時期と腕を上げた時の痛みを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My left shoulder has hurt since yesterday. Does saying it hurts when I raise my arm explain it clearly?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain when the left-shoulder pain started and the pain when raising your arm. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その説明は分かります。痛みが始まる前に、思い当たる出来事はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: That explanation is clear. Do you recall anything that happened before the pain started?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日は重い箱を運びました。ただ、それが原因かどうかは自分では分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 重い箱を運んだ事実を伝え痛みの原因とは断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I carried a heavy box yesterday. But I don't know myself whether that caused it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report carrying a heavy box without deciding it caused the pain. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出来事として記録し、原因の判断は診察で確認してもらいましょう。診察時の話し方についても希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll record it as an event and have the cause assessed during the examination. I'll also pass on how you'd like us to speak during the examination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 箱を運んだことと痛みの時期を分けて伝えます。診察でも短い質問をお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出来事と痛みの時期を分けて伝え診察でも短い質問を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain carrying the box separately from when the pain started. I'd like short questions during the examination too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the event from the timing of pain and request short questions during the examination too. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 話し方の希望も引き継ぎます。それでは、いったん失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on that communication preference too. I'll excuse myself for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の内容を伺います。今、その相手がご自宅の前にいる状況ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me your concern. Is that person in front of your home right now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今はいません。昨日、知らない人が来て、点検と言って玄関を開けるよう求めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の点検を名乗る訪問を説明し相手が今は不在と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not now. Yesterday a stranger came and asked me to open the front door, saying it was an inspection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain yesterday's visit claiming to be an inspection and say the person isn't there now. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 玄関を開けたり、室内に入れたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you open the door or let them inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開けませんでした。インターホン越しに会社名を聞きましたが、名前ははっきり覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 玄関未開放とインターホン越しの聞き取り不明を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I didn't open it. I asked the company name over the intercom, but I don't clearly remember it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you didn't open the door and didn't clearly retain the company name heard over the intercom. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 覚えている範囲で構いません。訪問した時刻や、残っている記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Whatever you remember is fine. Do you know the visit time or have any records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午後四時頃です。インターホンの録画はありますが、まだ保存方法を確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 午後四時頃の訪問と録画が未保存であることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Around four in the afternoon. There's an intercom recording, but I haven't checked how to save it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the visit time around four p.m. and say the recording hasn't been saved. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 上書きされる前に保存できるか、機器の案内を確認してください。無理に相手を探しに行く必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the device instructions to see whether you can save it before it's overwritten. There's no need to go looking for the person yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 録画の保存方法を確認します。聞き取れなかった会社名は、推測せず不明と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 録画保存を確かめ会社名を推測せず不明と扱う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check how to save the recording. I won't guess the company name I couldn't hear; I'll say it's unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll check how to save the recording and treat the company name as unknown without guessing. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それで構いません。点検を頼んだ覚えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's fine. Do you remember requesting an inspection?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 点検を頼んでいません。訪問時刻と録画の有無を整理して、家族にも共有します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 点検未依頼と時刻と録画情報を整理して家族に共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I didn't request one. I'll organize the visit time and whether there's a recording, and share that with my family too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you didn't request an inspection and will organize the time and recording details to share with family. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 伺った内容を記録します。ご相談ありがとうございました、お気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll record what you've told me. Thank you for consulting us; get home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの箱を発送されますか。送り先の記入はお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending this box? Have you filled in the destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書きましたが、家族から新しい住所が届きました。まだ発送せず、宛先を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送前に家族の新住所が届き宛先を訂正したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have, but my family sent me a new address. I'd like to correct it without sending the parcel yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your family sent a new address before shipment and you want to correct the destination. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい伝票に書き直しましょう。箱に直接書いた古い住所もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's rewrite it on a new label. Is the old address also written directly on the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 箱にも古い住所があります。二つの住所が見える状態では、紛らわしいですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱の直接記入の古い住所と新住所の併記が紛らわしいと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The old address is on the box too. Having both addresses visible would be confusing, wouldn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the old address written directly on the box alongside the new one would be confusing. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 古い住所が読み取れないようにして、新しい送り先をはっきり示してください。伝票を貼る場所も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Make the old address unreadable and clearly indicate the new destination. Let's also check where to attach the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 古い住所を隠してから、新しい伝票を平らな面に貼ります。郵便番号も変わったので、書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧住所を隠し平面に新伝票を貼り郵便番号も訂正すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll cover the old address, then stick the new label on a flat surface. The postal code changed too, so I'll rewrite it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll hide the old address, attach the new label on a flat surface, and correct the postal code too. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新しい住所の情報と、一項目ずつ照らし合わせてください。建物名や部屋番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Compare each item against the new address information. Is there a building name or room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 建物名と部屋番号もあります。短くせず、家族のメッセージどおりに記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 建物名と部屋番号を家族の情報どおり省略せず記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are both. I'll write them exactly as in my family's message without shortening them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll write the building name and room number as given by family without abbreviation. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、古い表示が残っていないかも見てから、大きさと重さを測りますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we'll check that no old markings remain before measuring the size and weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宛先を全部照合できました。古い表示も隠したので、この住所で発送の手続きをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先全項目と旧表示非表示を確認して発送手続きを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've matched all the destination details. The old markings are hidden too, so please process the shipment to this address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm all destination details and hidden old markings, and request shipment. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは発送方法をご案内します。ご利用ありがとうございます、どうぞお気を付けて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-33215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll explain the shipping options. Thank you for using our service, and take care.
